tokens.name: night
tokens.usage: The brand's dark ground: hero, footer, business card front, social posts. Text on it is on-dark (13.9:1) or on-dark-soft (8.2:1); the seal on it is orange (5.0:1).

tokens.name: night-2
tokens.usage: A second night step for panels and bands that sit on night. on-dark 12.3:1, on-dark-soft 7.2:1, orange 4.4:1 (large text and the seal only).

tokens.name: orange
tokens.usage: BoromTech Orange, the colour of the seal. On night: the seal and large accent text (5.0:1). On paper: the seal and fills only (3.2:1, never body text). Never on soft (2.7:1). Text on an orange fill is ink (5.4:1), never white (2.8:1).

tokens.name: orange-deep
tokens.usage: Pressed and hover state of orange fills, and the darker facet in seal illustrations. 4.2:1 on paper, 3.6:1 on soft: large text and graphics only.

tokens.name: rust
tokens.usage: Orange as text on light grounds (5.4:1 on paper, 4.6:1 on soft) and the seal on soft. High severity in reports. Never on night (2.9:1).

tokens.name: soft
tokens.usage: The warm light ground for quiet sections and callouts. Text on it is ink (14.6:1) or muted (5.3:1); the seal on it is rust.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Text on paper (17.2:1), sunken and soft, and on orange fills (5.4:1). The one-colour seal and lockup for single-ink print.

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Hover state of dark buttons on light grounds.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: The light ground: documents, reports, light sections, business card back.

tokens.name: sunken
tokens.usage: Wells, image placeholders, status pills and meters on paper. Text on it is ink or muted (5.4:1).

tokens.name: on-dark
tokens.usage: Text and the light seal on night (13.9:1) and night-2 (12.3:1).

tokens.name: on-dark-soft
tokens.usage: Secondary text on night (8.2:1) and night-2 (7.2:1): captions, ledes in small sizes, meta lines.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on paper (6.3:1), sunken (5.4:1) and soft (5.3:1). Not on night (2.5:1).

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines on paper: document header rules, table rows. Decorative only (1.3:1); never the only cue for a control's edge.

tokens.name: line-night
tokens.usage: Hairlines on night. Decorative only (1.6:1). An addition: the website has no rule on dark grounds yet.

tokens.name: good
tokens.usage: Done, paid, credited, on paper (5.3:1) and soft (4.5:1). Always paired with a word.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Medium severity, in review, due soon, on paper (5.9:1) and soft (5.1:1). Always paired with a word.

tokens.name: bad
tokens.usage: Critical severity, errors, overdue, on paper (5.5:1) and soft (4.7:1). Always paired with a word.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page ground for the current theme.

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: Wells and panels set into surface.

tokens.name: surface-inverse
tokens.usage: A band in the opposite ground: a night band on a paper page, a paper band on a night page.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Body text on surface and surface-2.

tokens.name: text-soft
tokens.usage: Secondary text on surface and surface-2 (at least 5.3:1 in both themes).

tokens.name: seal
tokens.usage: The seal on surface: 3.2:1 on paper, 5.0:1 on night. On soft use rust instead.

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: Orange as text on surface: links, eyebrow labels, inline emphasis (5.4:1 on paper, 5.0:1 on night).

tokens.name: on-orange
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an orange fill (5.4:1).

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Dividers on surface. Decorative only.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus outline, 3px with a 3px offset (site :focus-visible). 5.4:1 on paper, 5.0:1 on night.

tokens.name: status-good
tokens.usage: Good state as text on surface. Night value 7.8:1 on night; the brand's own green is 3.0:1 there.

tokens.name: status-warn
tokens.usage: Warning state as text on surface. Night value 8.1:1 on night.

tokens.name: status-bad
tokens.usage: Critical state as text on surface. Night value 6.2:1 on night.

families.display: "Bricolage Grotesque", "IBM Plex Sans Thai", "IBM Plex Sans", "Noto Sans SC", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif
families.text: "IBM Plex Sans Thai", "IBM Plex Sans", "Noto Sans SC", "PingFang SC", "Hiragino Sans GB", "Microsoft YaHei", system-ui, sans-serif
families.text-vi: "IBM Plex Sans", "IBM Plex Sans Thai", system-ui, sans-serif

groups.name: Display · Latin
groups.note: Bricolage Grotesque ExtraBold, the 96pt static cut the website ships (fonts/). Latin only: Thai and Chinese characters fall through to the text family.

styles.name: hero
styles.sample: AI can build it. Who will run it?
styles.usage: One headline per page or poster. Fluid on the web: clamp(40px, 5.6vw, 92px).

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Section titles. Fluid on the web: clamp(24px, 2.1vw, 30px).

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: The wordmark as live text in the site nav. Everywhere else use the outlined wordmark or lockup files.

styles.name: doc-mark
styles.usage: The wordmark in document headers: Audit Report, Weekly Update, Warranty.

groups.name: Display · Thai and Chinese
groups.note: Same sizes as the Latin display styles so a layout swaps language without reflowing. Looser leading for stacked Thai marks and CJK; tracking stays 0.

styles.name: hero-th
styles.sample: เอไอใครๆก็ทำได้ แต่ใครจะดูแล
styles.usage: Thai hero headline, IBM Plex Sans Thai Bold.

styles.name: hero-zh
styles.sample: AI 人人都会做，但谁来维护？
styles.usage: Simplified Chinese hero headline. Noto Sans SC Bold via the text stack.

styles.name: title-th
styles.sample: จากออดิต สู่การันตี

groups.name: Text
groups.note: IBM Plex Sans Thai for Thai and Latin. On Vietnamese pages use the text-vi stack (IBM Plex Sans first): Plex Sans Thai has no Vietnamese glyphs.

styles.name: subhead
styles.sample: Big-project standards for work of any size
styles.usage: h3 on the website: point headings and card titles.

styles.name: lede
styles.sample: เราดูแลระบบทั้งงานเล็กและใหญ่ พร้อมการันตีและราคาที่ชัดเจนตั้งแต่วันแรก
styles.usage: The paragraph under a hero headline. Max 32em.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: First, we audit the real code, servers and databases and report every risk.
styles.usage: Running text on the web. Thai body text may go to 1.7.

styles.name: document
styles.sample: Over five business days we open up your system layer by layer.
styles.usage: Body text in reports and printed documents (11pt in print).

styles.name: small
styles.sample: Assessment window 3–7 Nov 2026 · 182,400 LOC · 3 production hosts

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase eyebrows, Latin only. Thai and Chinese labels keep their case and 0 tracking.

groups.name: Data
groups.note: IBM Plex Mono, an addition for document IDs and code. The website has no mono face yet.

styles.name: id
styles.usage: Document and ticket IDs, versions, commit hashes.

tokens.name: space-xs
tokens.usage: Inside pills and tight inline gaps.

tokens.name: space-s
tokens.usage: Gaps between pills, chips and stacked list rows.

tokens.name: space-m
tokens.usage: The minimum page margin and gap on phones.

tokens.name: space-gap
tokens.usage: Gap between columns and stacked blocks at desktop (site --gap: clamp(16px, 2vw, 28px)); also the hero copy gap.

tokens.name: space-margin
tokens.usage: Page side margin at desktop (site --m: clamp(16px, 2.4vw, 36px)).

tokens.name: space-l
tokens.usage: Document padding and gaps between groups inside a section.

tokens.name: space-section
tokens.usage: Vertical padding of a chapter at desktop (site: clamp(96px, 12vw, 180px)).

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Everything: buttons, cards, sheets, images, the app icon artwork. BoromTech corners are square; the seal is the brand's only curve.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Status pills and progress meters only, so a rounded shape always reads as a state.

seal.note: The seal's geometry, in SVG user units. The stroke width is the system's unit s: clear space and the lockup gap are measured in it.

tokens.name: seal-box
tokens.usage: viewBox side of the standard seal (seal-*.svg) and of the website hero SVG.

tokens.name: seal-r
tokens.usage: Centre-line radius of the standard ring. Outer radius 475, inner 325.

tokens.name: seal-stroke
tokens.usage: Ring thickness = 1s. 37.5% of the radius; never change it.

tokens.name: seal-small-box
tokens.usage: viewBox side of the small-size seal and the favicon.

tokens.name: seal-small-r
tokens.usage: Centre-line radius of the small-size seal.

tokens.name: seal-small-stroke
tokens.usage: Small-size ring thickness, 47% of the radius: heavier so it holds at 16-32px.

tokens.name: seal-min-digital
tokens.usage: Smallest standard seal on screen. From 16 to 23px use the small-size seal.

tokens.name: seal-min-print
tokens.usage: Smallest seal in print. The lockup's minimum is the same height: 6mm tall (46mm wide), 24px tall on screen (183px wide).
